```{=html}
<style>
  :root{
    --brand:#e68a00; --brand-2:#b36b00; --bg:#fffaf3; --ink:#222;
  }
  body{ font-family: "Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif; background:var(--bg); margin:0; color:var(--ink); }

  .hero{
    text-align:center; padding:42px 18px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--brand) 0%, var(--brand-2) 100%); color:#fff;
  }
  .hero img{ max-width:280px; border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
  .hero h1{ font-size:2.4rem; margin:18px 0 8px; }
  .tag{ display:inline-block; background:#fff; color:#5a3b00; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; font-weight:600; margin:8px 6px 0; }

  /* ---------- REGISTRATION FORM SECTION ---------- */
  .reg-wrap{
    max-width:720px;
    margin:32px auto;
    padding:0 14px;
  }
  .reg-card{
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:18px 16px 22px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
    border:1px solid #f1e3d2;
  }
  .reg-card h3{ margin:2px 0 4px; color:var(--brand-2); font-size:1.2rem; line-height:1.35; }
  .reg-card p{ margin:6px 0 14px; line-height:1.55; font-size:.98rem; color:#444; }

  .form-embed{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    border-radius:12px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid #f1e3d2;
  }
  .form-embed iframe{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    height:1400px;   /* generous height => whole form flows, less nested scrolling */
    border:0;
  }

  .open-fallback{ text-align:center; margin:14px 0 2px; }
  .open-fallback a{
    display:inline-block;
    padding:.8rem 1.5rem;
    font-size:1rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:#fff;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),var(--brand-2));
    border-radius:999px;
    text-decoration:none;
    box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(230,138,0,.3);
  }
  .open-fallback small{ display:block; margin-top:8px; color:#8a5200; font-size:.85rem; }

  /* ---------- EVENT DETAIL CARDS ---------- */
  .wrap{ max-width:720px; margin:24px auto; padding:0 14px; }
  .cards{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr)); gap:18px; }
  .card{ background:#fff; border-radius:14px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
  .card h3{ margin:4px 0 10px; color:var(--brand-2); font-size:1.15rem; }
  .card p{ margin:6px 0; line-height:1.5; }

  .notice{
    border-left:6px solid var(--brand-2); background:#fff3e6; border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; margin:18px 0;
  }
  .notice strong{ color:#8a5200; }

  .footer{ text-align:center; padding:26px 14px; margin-top:42px; background:#fff0e0; border-top:2px solid var(--brand-2); }

  @media (max-width:600px){
    .hero h1{ font-size:1.9rem; }
    .reg-card{ padding:14px 12px 18px; }
    .reg-card h3{ font-size:1.08rem; }
    .form-embed iframe{ height:1550px; }
  }
</style>

<!-- hero -->
<div class="hero">

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- event details -->
<div class="wrap">
  <div class="cards">
    <div class="card">
      <h3>Event details (English)</h3>
      <p><strong>Date:</strong> 21 August 2026</p>
      <p><strong>Start time:</strong> 8:00 AM</p>
      <p><strong>Venue:</strong> Indoor stadium and nearby areas</p>
      <div class="notice">
        <strong>Registration deadline:</strong> please register before <strong>3:00 PM on 19 August 2026</strong>.
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h3>പരിപാടി വിവരങ്ങൾ (Malayalam)</h3>
      <p><strong>തീയതി:</strong> 2026 ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 21</p>
      <p><strong>ആരംഭ സമയം:</strong> രാവിലെ 8:00</p>
      <p><strong>വേദി:</strong> ഇൻഡോർ സ്റ്റേഡിയം & സമീപ പ്രദേശങ്ങൾ</p>
      <div class="notice">
        <strong>രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ അവസാന സമയം:</strong> <strong>2026 ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 19</strong> ഉച്ചയ്ക്ക് <strong>3:00</strong> മണിയ്ക്ക് മുമ്പ് രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്യണം.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="footer">
  🌼 wishing everyone a joyful and vibrant onam! 🌼
```
